crawl-batch.regex-on-full-url.evidence: cb8ac92: regexOnFullURL on POST /v1/crawl, /fc, the SDK types and MCP crawl; includePaths / excludePaths then match the link's canonical URL (scheme, lower-cased host, path, sorted query without tracking parameters) instead of its pathname; a refused link is pathDenied in the page's links_offered trace event and the report's discovery. Live A1/A2 (m2-live-checks-crawl-urls-2026-10-02.md, sandbox, test set #5): the host-anchored pattern admits ?page_num=2 and 3 only (3 pages, budgetExceeded null, the seed's event pathDenied 22, subtreeDenied 5, hostDenied 1); the control without the option refuses all 24 (1 page, pathDenied 24). Tests: packages/runtime/test/frontier.test.ts, packages/contracts/test/api.test.ts and firecrawl.test.ts, packages/mcp/test/tools.test.ts.

crawl-batch.ignore-query-parameters.evidence: cb8ac92: ignoreQueryParameters drops the whole query from every canonical URL (canonicalizeUrl ignoreQuery); the first variant seen is fetched (its url keeps the query, its canonicalUrl does not), later variants are refused as duplicates with collapsedInto and counted as collapsed, with up to 20 {url, into} samples in links_offered; a resume keys getStepByCanonicalUrl on the same canonical. Live B1/B2 (sandbox, test set #5): the ?per_page=100 seed is one page whose canonicalUrl is /pages/forms/, collapsed 6 (the 100-row page carries 6 page_num links, not the 24 of the 25-row page the plan counted), subtreeDenied 5, hostDenied 1, enqueued 0, and the samples name every merge, as row #5 requires; the control fetches 3 pages with collapsed 0. Tests: packages/runtime/test/canonicalize.test.ts, frontier.test.ts, orchestrator.test.ts.

crawl-batch.deduplicate-similar-urls.evidence: cb8ac92: deduplicateSimilarURLs (default true) keys the frontier's visited set by a visit key without scheme, leading www., trailing slash and index.html/.htm/.php; folded variants are collapsed with samples, the step's canonicalUrl stays a real URL; the rawBodySha256 backstop keeps status duplicate, counts in discovery.duplicateContent, and such pages are left out of GET /v1/crawl/:id/pages unless includeDuplicates=true (SDK getCrawlPages, MCP get_crawl_pages) and out of /fc status data while total counts them. Live C1/C2 (books.toscrape.com, sandbox): default 6 pages, none duplicate, /index.html collapsed into / (collapsed 1, duplicateContent 0); with false /index.html is fetched and recorded as a duplicate with the seed's rawBodySha256 (duplicateContent 1), /pages lists 5 pages and /pages?includeDuplicates=true 6 with its markdown null. Known leftover: a content-hash duplicate still costs its fetch and a page of maxPages (C2 reached 6 with the duplicate among them). Tests: packages/runtime/test/canonicalize.test.ts, frontier.test.ts, orchestrator.test.ts, packages/api/test/app.test.ts, crawlLifecycle.test.ts, packages/contracts/test/firecrawl.test.ts.

crawl-batch.crawl-entire-domain.evidence: cb8ac92: crawlEntireDomain (default false) keeps links on the seed host inside the seed's path subtree (its directory, the directory of the file it names, or itself plus /; a redirect of the seed adds the final URL's subtree), refused as subtree_denied and counted as subtreeDenied; true follows the whole host; /fc maps v1 allowBackwardLinks and v2 crawlEntireDomain. Live D1/D2 (docs.python.org/3/tutorial/, test set #32, one 10-page fetch per check): default gives 10 pages all under /3/tutorial/ with subtreeDenied 168 and the seed's event naming 15; true gives 8 of 10 pages outside it (/3/whatsnew/changelog.html, /3/library/index.html, /3/index.html, ...) with subtreeDenied 0. Known leftovers: W2L's subtree is a directory convention where Firecrawl tests a plain path prefix; a task stored before the option resumes with the whole host; the w2l crawl CLI keeps the whole host and has no flag yet. Tests: packages/runtime/test/frontier.test.ts, packages/api/test/app.test.ts, files.test.ts, firecrawl.test.ts.

crawl-batch.allow-subdomains.evidence: cb8ac92: allowSubdomains admits every host under the seed's apex (the seed host with one leading www. removed; no public-suffix list); allowlistedDomains adds hosts to the seed host and its twin instead of replacing them; when the request names hosts, the governance allowlist carries the seed host, its twin, the listed hosts and *.apex under allowSubdomains, otherwise none. Live E1/E2 (www.gov.uk statistics page, test set #26, one fetch per check): with the option and an assets-anchored regexOnFullURL filter, 3 pages: the seed plus Energy_Trends_September_2026.pdf (file pdf, 1,731,670 bytes, sha256 c19e2a7b...) and ET_5.1_SEP_26.xlsx (file xlsx, 368,197 bytes, sha256 2be6ab03...) on assets.publishing.service.gov.uk, each with its own robots_checked (no_robots) for that host; the control gives 1 page with hostDenied 11 naming the eight assets URLs. Sandbox E3: toscrape.com gives pages on toscrape.com, quotes.toscrape.com and books.toscrape.com (hostDenied 0). Known leftover: a seed on www.gov.uk admits every *.gov.uk host. Tests: packages/runtime/test/frontier.test.ts, packages/api/test/app.test.ts.

crawl-batch.allow-external-links.evidence: cb8ac92: allowExternalLinks admits any http(s) host; the crawl's governance policy then carries no allowlist, and every page keeps its own robots.txt read, SSRF verdict and identity record on its lane; with allowlistedDomains it is refused ('allowExternalLinks cannot be combined with allowlistedDomains'); without it foreign hosts are hostDenied, counted and sampled. Live F1/F2 (toscrape.com, sandbox; the hub links only the two sandbox hosts): with the option 3 pages on three hosts, the two followed pages with their own robots_checked (no_robots) and discovered {via: link, from: https://toscrape.com/}; the control gives 1 page with hostDenied 9 naming the books and quotes URLs. Tests: packages/runtime/test/frontier.test.ts, packages/contracts/test/api.test.ts, packages/api/test/app.test.ts (one loopback server reached as 127.0.0.1 and localhost), packages/mcp/test/tools.test.ts.
